text:
tess: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. Recurring long-context bursts again. Need concrete SLO tweaks, owners for dashboards/runbooks, and a short mitigation plan.

omar: Short summary: a handful of >2500-token requests filled batch windows and caused GPU queueing; p99 went up to ~1.7s for ~7m. Small interactive traffic suffered.

leah: I can own dashboards/alerts. Plan: token-size histogram (per-route), per-instance queue depth, KV-cache hit ratio, request-duration vs token-count heatmap, and error-budget burn panel. ETA 5 days.

mike: Oncall notes: observed KV-cache miss spike (45%), queue depth >160 on two instances, and avg batch size jumped by 3x. We already tried soft-throttle but it was manual.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-488 | Sev2 | start=2189999000 | end=2189999600 | primary=serving-runtime | link=https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-488

omar: Draft short-term SLO changes (temporary):
```
- metric: inference_latency
  window: 30d
  targets:
    p95: <= 230ms
- metric: inference_latency_tail
  window: 14d
  targets:
    p99: <= 1.05s  # temporary guard during batching rollout
notes: Re-evaluate p99 after canary and 7d stable telemetry.
```

leah: Alerts I plan to add: sustained p99 > 1s for 3m -> page; queue_depth > 140 for 2m -> page; kv_cache_miss > 30% for 5m -> channel. Each alert will include an owner and link to playbook.

tess: Mitigations (short-term): - enable token-aware soft-throttle (Retry-After + sampled fallback) - prototype automatic fallback to compact model when queue_depth > 150 and batching_latency > 200ms - add CI perf sim (90% small + 10% large) to gate SLO PR

omar: I can own the soft-throttle + CI sim (due 2026-04-20). Will instrument `X-Redwood-Fallback` header for fallback events and sample 5% of outputs to private QA bucket.

mike: I'll draft runbook updates (emergency steps, drain commands, how to flip fallback) and include rollback criteria: auto-rollback if canary-increased 5xx by >1% or quality drift >5% on sampled outputs. Runbook ETA 2026-04-18.

leah: Dashboard PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/801 - will attach screenshots and add error-budget panel.

omar: SLO PR will include measurement notes and rollback gates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slo-config/pull/526 (draft).

tess: Action items recap:
- leah: dashboards + alerts PR (first pass by 2026-04-19)
- omar: implement soft-throttle + CI perf sim + fallback header (due 2026-04-20)
- mike: runbook + rollback criteria (due 2026-04-18)
- tess: add items to postmortem tracker and schedule recurring 2-week "long-context review" until 30d stable

leah: I'll also add an alert-driven checklist in the dashboard so when p99 pages it shows top correlated metrics and quick runbook links.

omar: One more question: temporary p99 relaxation window length? I vote 14 days with an explicit canary milestone at 7 days.

tess: Agreed. 14d window, re-evaluate after canary + 7d stable telemetry. We'll set calendar reminders and gate SLO re-tightening on metrics.

pager: Reminder created: "Long-context review (recurring)" every 2 weeks starting 2026-04-22. Attendees: @eng-sre

mike: Ack. If anyone needs to reassign or move dates, raise here. Let's close P0 items this sprint. :thumbsup:
